entities.title: csharp-indexer tests
entities.summary: The xunit suite for csharp-indexer, run with dotnet test tests from the tool's folder.
entities.purpose: Checks the tool mostly in process: TempRepo creates a throwaway git repository with given files and an engine on a temporary state directory, and the test classes exercise the index, analysis, tools, the terse C# view, daemon (on a temporary socket), hook policy, init, uninit and report against it; ViewTests also builds views from source text without a repository. ControlTests runs the built executable (src/bin/<configuration>/<framework>/<runtime>/csharp-indexer) as a real daemon on a temporary state folder for status, stop, restart and help. Tests are named test_<unit>_<case> and must pass on Linux and macOS; the FSEvents test returns immediately elsewhere.
boundaries: What each test class checks is recorded in the verification.json of the folder it checks: src/Index, src/Analysis, src/Tools, src/View, src/Daemon, src/Cli and src/.

The tests need git on PATH; ControlTests needs the build's own executable for this machine's runtime, which dotnet test builds. The external-regex test checks the fallback only where rg or a PCRE-enabled git grep is installed, and accepts bad_regex otherwise.
